mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the past month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI annualized growth > 2% does not correlate with negative 20-day forward returns (Pearson r > -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (GDPC1) by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals a weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or GDPC1 QoQ growth < -1% does not correlate with negative 60-day forward returns (Pearson r > -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE increase > 0.5pp does not correlate with negative 20-day forward returns (Pearson r > -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a strengthening supply side, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO MoM growth > 1% does not correlate with positive 5-day forward returns (Pearson r < 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 3 months signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or a sustained decrease in FEDFUNDS does not correlate with positive 20-day forward returns (Pearson r < 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) and Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (GDPC1) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint increase in HOUST and GDPC1 does not correlate with positive 20-day forward returns (Pearson r < 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 over the past month signals labor market contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or PAYEMS decrease > 100,000 does not correlate with negative 60-day forward returns (Pearson r > -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% over the past month signals tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or FEDFUNDS increase > 0.25% does not correlate with negative 5-day forward returns (Pearson r > -0.1).
